integrity_statement: All proof claims are analytical; the standalone checker supplies finite numerical corroboration only. Prior geometric and statistical results are credited. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Only independent uniform planar directions, independent of the positive radial lengths.
The iid radial law must have a finite second moment; no universality conclusion is asserted for infinite radial second moment.
Convergence is in distribution, with no total variation or quantitative rate asserted.
The one-spike example shows non-universality outside the diffuseness hypothesis; it is not an exhaustive nondiffuse classification.
Historical priority may be affected by differently formulated results in weighted circular Sobolev statistics.
title: Perimeter-normalized random zonogons: universal second-order area law and a sharp spike obstruction
